query:
SELECT e.id, e.turn_id, e.payload #- '{outcome,image}' AS "payload!"
            FROM turn_events e
            JOIN chat_turns t ON t.id=e.turn_id
            WHERE t.conversation_id=$1 AND t.room_message_id IS NULL AND t.call_id IS NULL AND e.id>$2
            ORDER BY e.id
            LIMIT 100
